ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW() , ISCHANGED(Lead__c) ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Lead__r.Status__c, "Converted"), ISPICKVAL(Lead__r.Status__c, "Dropped"), ISPICKVAL(Lead__r.Status__c, "Dropped by Central desk") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An event cannot be created for a lead with status Converted, Dropped or Dropped by Central Desk
